utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m still meaning to bring over my old toolbox, if that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot, Oren. Thank you — just bring it by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll drop it off later today if I can remember where I put it. Glad to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details, so what’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re gathering the repair supplies first, then we’ll sort them and hand them out to anyone who needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks. I’ll help gather the supplies and sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Uli — what’s the repair drive focused on, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s mostly for fixing up small things around the block — loose steps, leaking taps, that sort of thing. If you can help organize or bring a few supplies, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can help organize. What supplies should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and invite folks over right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll note that folks can head over right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll let everyone know to come by right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Hana — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you handle collecting the donated tools and keeping a quick list of what comes in?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll collect the donated tools and keep a quick list of what comes in. I’ll let you know if anything’s missing or needs follow-up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you help sort the donated tools and check the boxes for anything missing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated tools and check the boxes for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving, Bo. Let’s keep it simple and make sure the neighbors know exactly how to sign up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely—simple is best. I’ll help make the sign-up clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo—let’s draft a short flyer with a phone number and a drop-in time. I’ll keep it neighbor-friendly and easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and whether we have enough volunteers for the repair drive. Can we confirm the schedule and who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: we’ll confirm the schedule first, then fill in who’s bringing tools and supplies. If you want, I can make a quick list and we can check off the volunteers one by one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—let’s do the schedule first and then go volunteer by volunteer so we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. If you hear anything about the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out soon, so I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little supply list going for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll see if I can help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can check, but can you confirm what counts as priority supplies first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Priority supplies are the basics we’ll run through first: tape, screws, batteries, gloves, and a few clean cloths. If you’re unsure, tell me what you’ve got and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my toolbox and a few spares for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, Gus — thank you. I’ll let everyone know you’re bringing the toolbox and spares.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help, Jules — I’ll swing by with it before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so helpful, Faye — I’m still confirming the exact time, but it should be after school. If you can bring a few gloves and maybe some tape, that’d be amazing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll bring gloves and tape, and I’ll keep the afternoon open once you confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s super helpful, thanks. I’m still locking in the exact time, but I’ll send it as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—just text me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you want me to bring any tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: If you can, please bring a screwdriver set and some gloves. And maybe a flashlight, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll bring a screwdriver set, gloves, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm — this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — nothing’s changed there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to make sure. What time’s it starting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can share the plan whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rosa — I’m ready, and I can help keep track of supplies. Just tell me what you need, and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — thank you, Cleo. We need donation drop-off boxes, a short list of common repair items, and a couple of volunteers for intake and sorting.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by for the repair drive, but I’ll need to keep it brief today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli — brief is fine. Come by when you can, and I’ll have it ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll swing by soon and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think folks are still collecting tools and materials, and I meant to check the signup sheet, but I forgot to do it again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries—if you hear any updates, let me know. I’m happy to help once I know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. We mainly need a few tools and maybe some spare parts, if you’ve got any.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can probably spare a few tools. Tell me what you still need most.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Could you handle collecting the donated tools and checking them off as they come in? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can collect the donated tools and check them off as they come in. Just let me know where you want me stationed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Gus, I’m putting the word out about the repair drive—want me to add your name or swing by with details?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, add my name—I’m happy to help out. Swing by with the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll add your name and drop by soon with the details. Really appreciate you pitching in!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive. What’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — we still need a few folks to cover the east side pickup and one more truck for the bigger items. I can point you to the spots that are still open.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the east side pickup and I’ve got a truck for the bigger items. Point me to the open spots and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—anything I should know while I’m out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Nothing new from me yet, sorry—I’d just check with whoever’s organizing it before you head back. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I’ll ask around while I’m out. If you hear anything later, just let me know.
